--- Table 6: adventureworks.production.product ---
Domain: Product
Description: Products sold or used in the manfacturing of sold products.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each product in the catalog, serving as the primary key for product-related transactions and relationships
  - sellstartdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when the product became available for sale, marking the beginning of the product's active sales lifecycle

  - weightunitmeasurecode (character(3)) [FK]: Unit of measurement for the product weight, such as LB (pounds) or KG (kilograms), ensuring consistent weight interpretation
  - standardcost (numeric): Baseline cost used for inventory valuation, margin calculation, and standard costing accounting purposes
  - style (character(2)): Product style classification code that categorizes products by style variant for segmentation and reporting
  - makeflag (boolean): Boolean indicator showing whether the product is manufactured in-house (true) or purchased from external vendors (false)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the product record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization
  - finishedgoodsflag (boolean): Boolean flag indicating if the product is a finished good ready for customer sale versus a raw material or component
  - productsubcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key linking to the product subcategory classification, enabling hierarchical product categorization
  - productmodelid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the product model specification, linking to detailed model and engineering information
  - productline (character(2)): Product line code classifying products into product families such as R (Road), M (Mountain), or T (Touring) for marketing and reporting
  - safetystocklevel (smallint(16,0)): Minimum inventory buffer quantity to prevent stockouts during lead times, protecting against demand variability
  - size (character varying(5)): Product size attribute for items like clothing, footwear, or equipment where size is relevant to customer selection
